title: A Disturbance in the Force: Force Actuation on the RAVEN II Surgical Robot with Parallel Motor-Cable Units
description:
arXiv:2608.06488v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Difficulty in haptic feedback for surgical robots has been a long-term problem for decades. In recent years, learning-based force estimation from robot states suggests desirable accuracy without the necessity of extra sensors. However, challenges remain in obtaining representative training data in which the robot moves in the workspace under various external forces. In this work, a parallel motor-cable system is developed.
